bug_fixed.description: KYC fields (aadhaar, pan, tfn, blood_group, passport_number, visa_type, photo_url) were not being saved when creating employees
bug_fixed.root_cause: The mgt_employee_create endpoint in /app/backend/server.py was missing the KYC fields in the employee object being inserted into MongoDB. The routes/employees.py had the correct implementation but server.py was being used.
bug_fixed.fix_applied: Added KYC fields to the employee object in mgt_employee_create and mgt_employee_update endpoints in server.py
